social_media.headline: Strong Geomagnetic Conditions Reached
social_media.summary: Geomagnetic activity has reached the G3 (Strong) level. Severe or extreme conditions remain possible as additional coronal mass ejections reach Earth.
what_we_know: The active Warning remains in effect through 0600 UTC Mon May 13 2024.
Additional CME arrivals may produce severe or extreme conditions.
Another alert will be issued only if conditions escalate to G4 or G5.

footer.left: Continue heightened monitoring and follow sector procedures.

visual.alt_text: Observation graphic for G3 Strong geomagnetic storm conditions.
